help.pageSubtitle: Learn how to use all of Keep's features
help.footer: This is your personal instance of Keep

workspace.title: What is a Workspace?
workspace.text: A Workspace is an independent file space with its own root folder. Think of it as a separate "drive": what you upload in one workspace doesn't mix with what you upload in another.
list: Every user gets a default workspace when they sign up
You can create several workspaces to separate contexts (for example, personal and work)
Folders and files in each workspace are independent of one another
workspace.tip: Switch workspaces from the selector in the top bar, next to the logo. To create a new one, choose "Create workspace" at the end of the list.

navigation.title: Navigating folders
navigation.text: The file explorer shows the full folder tree on the left and the contents of the current folder on the right.
list: Click a folder in the side tree, or a folder card, to enter it
The breadcrumb at the top shows where you are and lets you go back to a previous folder
On mobile, the folder tree opens with the "Folders" button
navigation.tip: Use the search bar at the top to jump straight to a file or folder by name, without navigating folder by folder.

upload.title: Uploading files
upload.text: There are several ways to upload files to the folder you're currently in.
list1: "Upload file" button in the folder sidebar
Drag and drop one or more files onto the screen
On mobile, tapping the empty background of the content panel opens the file picker
list2: Each file has a maximum allowed size
Uploads are processed several at a time, but with a concurrency limit to avoid overloading the server
upload.tip: If you upload many files at once and some fail, you'll see a notice indicating how many couldn't be uploaded, without affecting the rest.

organize.title: Organize: create, move, rename and delete
list: Right-click on a folder's background and choose "New folder" to add a subfolder
Drag a file or folder card and drop it onto another folder (in the panel or in the side tree) to move it
Right-click on a file or folder for "Rename", "Download" or "Delete"
organize.tip: Deleting a folder also deletes everything inside it. This can't be undone, so the app asks you to confirm before applying it.

selection.title: Multiple selection
selection.text: You can select several files or folders at once to download or delete them together.
list: Hover over a card (or tap it on mobile) to see the selection checkbox in the top-left corner
With at least one item selected, a bar appears with the available actions: Download, Delete and an option to clear the selection
selection.tip: The selection is cleared automatically when you switch folders.

share.title: Sharing files
share.text: A file can be shared with other applications so they can access it directly, without having to download it and upload it again by hand.
list: Right-click on a file and choose "Share with"
Choose the target application from the submenu
A small avatar on the file card shows which apps it's shared with
share.tip: This option only appears for users with the administrator role.
